findings.text: blocking: The unchained-holder input includes lineage_paths and historical_edges from relatives rather than only sources this name recorded; 28 of the 72 committed unchained rows have no own recorded path or resolution ID, so their holder identity is not established by the required evidence.

blocking: Subtracting descendants but not ancestors allows a source-holding ancestor to be labeled unchained even though a lineage chain links it to the sourceless name, distorting the holder and dropped-edge populations.

blocking: Any one matching source qualifies an exhausted predecessor as an orphan even when other sources it recorded were dropped; the single-source and wrong-source fixtures at :61-96 cannot catch a partial transfer before retirement.

blocking: The report explicitly has no observed orphan witness, while the plan requires a named graph witness for every population in addition to a planted fixture, so that done-when remains unmet and needs a decision if the live population is truly empty.

follow-on: The unchained-holder assertion reads the same unchained_live_holders field that classify used to assign that population, so a regression in locating or validating holders leaves the assertion green; the dropped-edge checks at :603-611 likewise reuse source_locations.
